bans.hint: Tap the days to close or reopen. Requests on a closed day lose their dates.
bans.selected: {count, plural, =0 {No days selected} one {# day selected} other {# days selected}}
bans.banned: {count, plural, one {# day closed} other {# days closed}}
bans.unbanned: {count, plural, one {# day reopened} other {# days reopened}}

book.hint: Tap the first day, then the last (up to {max} days). We hold them for 24 hours while you fill in the request.
book.hintSuperAdmin: Tap the first day, then the last. As a super admin you can book any day.
book.pickDays: Pick the days on the calendar

requests.none: No requests yet. Book dates on the calendar to start one.
requests.title: Requests

request.cancelConfirm: Its dates become free for other departments. This can't be undone.
request.holdBody: Fill in the event and both briefs, then submit before the hold runs out:
request.lostDatesExpired: The 24-hour hold ran out, so these dates were released
request.lostDatesBanned: Logistics closed one of your days, so the request lost its dates
request.lostDatesBody: Everything you filled in is kept. Pick new dates to carry on.

details.title: Event title
details.presenterEmailHint: Required if any day is online.
details.locationScopeHint: An event outside the university is unofficial.
details.descriptionPlaceholder: What will attendees do and learn?

submit.title: Submit to Design and Logistics
submit.ready: Everything is filled in. Submitting sends the request to both teams at once.
submit.complete: Everything's filled in. Submit when you're ready.
submit.finishLaterSaved: Draft saved. Everything you filled in will be here when you come back.
submit.finishLaterSavedHold: Draft saved. Come back and submit before your 24-hour hold runs out.
submit.finishLaterFailed: Some changes couldn't be saved. Check the highlighted message and try again.
submit.stillMissing: {count, plural, one {# thing left before you can submit} other {# things left before you can submit}}
submit.incomplete: {count, plural, one {# field still needs filling in} other {# fields still need filling in}}

briefs.linksHint: One link per line (Google Drive, etc.).

design.rule: No design is made without clear content.
design.content: Content (the text that goes in the design)
design.ideaPlaceholder: The look and feel you have in mind

logistics.pickModesFirst: Choose each day's mode in the event details first; the questions here depend on it.
logistics.meetLink: OK for Logistics to create the Google Meet link?

kinds.dates_banned: Logistics closed a day of {title}; pick new dates
kinds.hold_expired: The hold on {title} ran out; book dates again
kinds.task_done: A team finished its part of {title}

inbox.title: Waiting on your team
inbox.none: Nothing is waiting on your team.

review.title: Progress
review.returnHint: Design can return a request once, within two days of receiving it. The team then has 12 hours to fix it, or loses points for each late day.
review.penalty: Late fix: {points, plural, one {# point} other {# points}} off for {days, plural, one {# late day} other {# late days}}, taken when the event is published.
review.yourTurnHint: Read the request below, then mark your part done when it's finished.
review.returnedHint: Fix what the notes ask for in the forms below, then resubmit.

publish.title: Publish the event
publish.hint: Every team is done. Publishing creates the event in Events as a draft; an admin reviews it and opens registration.
publish.imageHint: You can also add it later from the event page.
publish.done: Published as event #{id} (a draft for admins to review).

autosave.error: Couldn't save. Retrying when you edit again

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.subtitle: Who can do what in the admin app

grants.title: Grants
grants.hint: Give members of your department extra permissions for this semester. Grants end with the semester.
grants.noMembers: This department has no plain members this semester.
grants.noDepartments: You can't grant permissions in any department.

leaders.title: What leaders and VPs can do
leaders.hint: Pick "Every department" to set what all leaders and VPs get. Pick a department to give its leaders and VPs extra permissions on top of that.
leaders.sharedSummary: Every leader and VP in every department has these {count} permissions.
leaders.departmentSummary: {department}'s leaders and VPs have the {shared} permissions every leader has (locked below), plus {extra} just for {department}.

superAdmins.title: Super admins
superAdmins.hint: Super admins can do anything, to any department. They add and remove each other.
superAdmins.removeHint: They keep whatever their department roles give them.

memberDetails.description: Contact and university details for this member.
